ddns_restrict_static.description: Determines if an option to restrict DDNS update request to resource records which are marked as 'STATIC' is enabled or disabled.

default_bulk_host_name_template.description: Default bulk host name of a Grid DNS.

default_ttl.description: The default TTL value of a Grid DNS object. This interval tells the secondary how long the data can be cached.

disable_edns.description: Determines if the EDNS0 support for queries that require recursive resolution on Grid members is enabled or not.

dns64_groups.description: The list of DNS64 synthesis groups associated with this Grid DNS object.

dns_cache_acceleration_ttl.description: The minimum TTL value, in seconds, that a DNS record must have in order for it to be cached by the DNS Cache Acceleration service. An integer from 1 to 65000 that represents the TTL in seconds.

dns_health_check_anycast_control.description: Determines if the anycast failure (BFD session down) is enabled on member failure or not.

dns_health_check_domain_list.description: The list of domain names for the DNS health check.

dns_health_check_interval.description: The time interval (in seconds) for DNS health check.

dns_health_check_recursion_flag.description: Determines if the recursive DNS health check is enabled or not.

dns_health_check_retries.description: The number of DNS health check retries.

dns_health_check_timeout.description: The DNS health check timeout interval (in seconds).

dns_query_capture_file_time_limit.description: The time limit (in minutes) for the DNS query capture file.

dnssec_blacklist_enabled.description: Determines if the blacklist rules for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_dns64_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS64 groups for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS security extension is enabled or not.

dnssec_expired_signatures_enabled.description: Determines when the DNS member accepts expired signatures.

enable_ksk_auto_rollover.description: If set to True, automatic rollovers for the signing key is enabled.

ksk_algorithms.description: A list of Key Signing Key Algorithms.

algorithm.description: The signing key algorithm.

size.description: The signing key size, in bits.

ksk_rollover.description: Key Signing Key rollover interval, in seconds.

ksk_size.description: Key Signing Key size, in bits. Deprecated.

ksk_rollover_notification_config.description: This field controls events for which users will be notified.

ksk_snmp_notification_enabled.description: Enable SNMP notifications for KSK related events.

ksk_email_notification_enabled.description: Enable email notifications for KSK related events.

nsec3_salt_min_length.description: The minimum length for NSEC3 salts. RFC 9276 recommends empty salt (0 octets) for optimal resolver compatibility and reduced computational overhead.

nsec3_salt_max_length.description: The maximum length for NSEC3 salts. RFC 9276 recommends empty salt (0 octets) for optimal resolver compatibility and reduced computational overhead.

nsec3_iterations.description: The number of iterations used for hashing NSEC3. RFC 9276 Section 3.1 mandates that this value MUST be set to zero (0) to ensure DNSSEC resolver compatibility and alleviate computational burdens on validating resolvers.

zsk_algorithms.description: A list of Zone Signing Key Algorithms.

algorithm.description: The signing key algorithm.

size.description: The signing key size, in bits.

zsk_rollover.description: Zone Signing Key rollover interval, in seconds.

zsk_size.description: Zone Signing Key size, in bits. Deprecated.

dnssec_negative_trust_anchors.description: A list of zones for which the server does not perform DNSSEC validation.

dnssec_nxdomain_enabled.description: Determines if the NXDOMAIN rules for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_rpz_enabled.description: Determines if the RPZ policies for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_trusted_keys.description: The list of trusted keys for the DNSSEC feature.

fqdn.description: The FQDN of the domain for which the member validates responses to recursive queries.

algorithm.description: The DNSSEC algorithm used to generate the key.

secure_entry_point.description: The secure entry point flag, if set it means this is a KSK configuration.

dnssec_must_be_secure.description: Responses must be DNSSEC secure for this hierarchy/domain.

dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS security validation is enabled or not.

dnstap_receiver_address_or_fqdn.description: Address or FQDN of DNSTAP receiver.

domains_to_capture_dns_queries.description: The list of domains for DNS query capture.

dtc_dns_queries_specific_behavior.description: Setting to control specific behavior for DTC DNS responses for incoming lbdn matched queries.

dtc_edns_prefer_client_subnet.description: Determines whether to prefer the client address from the edns-client-subnet option for DTC or not.

status.description: The status of the scheduled backup.

execute.description: The state for scheduled backup or restore operation.

backup_type.description: The destination of the backup files.

keep_local_copy.description: Determines whether the local backup performed before uploading backup to remote storage.

weekday.description: The day of the week when the backup is performed.

hour_of_day.description: The hour of the day past 12:00 AM the backup is performed.

minutes_past_hour.description: The minute of the hour when the backup is performed.

username.description: The user name on the backup server.

password.description: The user password on the backup server.

backup_server.description: The IP address of the backup server.

path.description: The directory path to the backup file stored on the server.

restore_type.description: The destination of the restore files.

restore_server.description: The IP address of the restore server.

restore_username.description: The user name on the restore server.

restore_password.description: The password on the restore server.

restore_path.description: The directory path to the restored file on the server.

nios_data.description: Determines whether the restore of the NIOS data is enabled.

discovery_data.description: Determines whether the restore the NetMRI data is enabled.

splunk_app_data.description: Determines whether the restore of the Splunk application data is enabled.

enable.description: Determines whether the scheduled backup is enabled.

use_keys.description: If set, scp backup support based on keys

key_type.description: If set, scp backup support based on keys type

upload_keys.description: If set, scp backup support to upload keys

download_keys.description: If set, scp backup support to download keys

dtc_topology_ea_list.description: The DTC topology extensible attribute definition list. When configuring a DTC topology, users may configure classification as either "Geographic" or "Extensible Attributes". Selecting extensible attributes will replace supported Topology database labels (Continent, Country, Subdivision, City) with the names of the selection EA types and provide values extracted from DHCP Network Container, Network and Range objects with those extensible attributes.

edns_udp_size.description: Advertises the EDNS0 buffer size to the upstream server. The value should be between 512 and 4096 bytes. The recommended value is between 512 and 1220 bytes.

email.description: The email address of a Grid DNS object.

enable_blackhole.description: Determines if the blocking of DNS queries is enabled or not.

enable_blacklist.description: Determines if a blacklist is enabled or not.

enable_capture_dns_queries.description: Determines if the capture of DNS queries is enabled or disabled.

enable_capture_dns_responses.description: Determines if the capture of DNS responses is enabled or disabled.

enable_client_subnet_forwarding.description: Determines whether to enable forwarding EDNS client subnet options to upstream servers.

enable_client_subnet_recursive.description: Determines whether to enable adding EDNS client subnet options in recursive resolution. The client_subnet_domains parameter value must not be empty to enable the enable_client_subnet_recursive parameter.

enable_delete_associated_ptr.description: Determines if the ability to automatically remove associated PTR records while deleting A or AAAA records is enabled or not.

enable_dns64.description: Determines if the DNS64 support is enabled or not.

enable_dns_health_check.description: Determines if the DNS health check is enabled or not.

enable_dnstap_auth_queries.description: Enable DNSTAP for authoritative query messages.

enable_dnstap_auth_responses.description: Enable DNSTAP for authoritative response messages.

enable_dnstap_client_queries.description: Enable DNSTAP for client query messages.

enable_dnstap_client_responses.description: Enable DNSTAP for client response messages.

enable_dnstap_forwarder_queries.description: Enable DNSTAP for forwarder query messages.

enable_dnstap_forwarder_responses.description: Enable DNSTAP for forwarder response messages.

enable_dnstap_queries.description: Determines whether the query messages need to be forwarded to DNSTAP or not.

enable_dnstap_resolver_queries.description: Enable DNSTAP for resolver query messages.

enable_dnstap_resolver_responses.description: Enable DNSTAP for resolver response messages.

enable_dnstap_responses.description: Determines whether the response messages need to be forwarded to DNSTAP or not.

enable_dnstap_violations_tls.description: Determines whether the violations messages need to be forwarded to DNSTAP or not.

enable_excluded_domain_names.description: Determines if excluding domain names from captured DNS queries and responses is enabled or disabled.

enable_fixed_rrset_order_fqdns.description: Determines if the fixed RRset order FQDN is enabled or not.

enable_ftc.description: Determines whether Fault Tolerant Caching (FTC) is enabled.

enable_gss_tsig.description: Determines whether all appliances in the Grid are enabled to receive GSS-TSIG authenticated updates from DNS clients.

enable_host_rrset_order.description: Determines if the host RRset order is enabled or not.

enable_hsm_signing.description: Determines whether Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) are enabled for key generation and signing. Note, that you must configure the HSM group with at least one enabled HSM.

enable_notify_source_port.description: Determines if the notify source port at the Grid Level is enabled or not.

enable_query_rewrite.description: Determines if the DNS query rewrite is enabled or not.

enable_query_source_port.description: Determines if the query source port at the Grid Level is enabled or not.

excluded_domain_names.description: The list of domains that are excluded from DNS query and response capture.

expire_after.description: The expiration time of a Grid DNS object. If the secondary DNS server fails to contact the primary server for the specified interval, the secondary server stops giving out answers about the zone because the zone data is too old to be useful.

directory.description: The directory to save the captured DNS queries and responses.

server_address_or_fqdn.description: The server address or a FQDN name of the destination server for DNS capture transfer.

password.description: The password to access the destination server directory.

type.description: The transfer protocol for the captured DNS queries and responses.

username.description: The username to access the destination server directory.

port.description: Transfer scp port.

filter_aaaa.description: The type of AAAA filtering for this member DNS object.

filter_aaaa_list.description: The list of IPv4 addresses and networks from which queries are received. AAAA filtering is applied to these addresses.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

fixed_rrset_order_fqdns.description: The fixed RRset order FQDN. If this field does not contain an empty value, the appliance will automatically set the enable_fixed_rrset_order_fqdns field to 'true', unless the same request sets the enable field to 'false'.

fqdn.description: The FQDN of the fixed RRset configuration item.

record_type.description: The record type for the specified FQDN in the fixed RRset configuration.

forward_only.description: Determines if member sends queries to forwarders only. When the value is "true", the member sends queries to forwarders only, and not to other internal or Internet root servers.

forward_updates.description: Determines if secondary servers is allowed to forward updates to the DNS server or not.

forwarders.description: The forwarders for the member. A forwarder is essentially a name server to which other name servers first send all of their off-site queries. The forwarder builds up a cache of information, avoiding the need for the other name servers to send queries off-site.

ftc_expired_record_timeout.description: The timeout interval (in seconds) after which the expired Fault Tolerant Caching (FTC)record is stale and no longer valid.

ftc_expired_record_ttl.description: The TTL value (in seconds) of the expired Fault Tolerant Caching (FTC) record in DNS responses.

gen_eadb_from_hosts.description: Flag for taking EA values from IPAM Hosts into consideration for the DTC topology EA database.

gen_eadb_from_network_containers.description: Flag for taking EA values from IPAM Network Containers into consideration for the DTC topology EA database.

gen_eadb_from_networks.description: Flag for taking EA values from IPAM Network into consideration for the DTC topology EA database.

gen_eadb_from_ranges.description: Flag for taking EA values from IPAM Ranges into consideration for the DTC topology EA database.

gss_tsig_keys.description: The list of GSS-TSIG keys for a Grid DNS object.

last_queried_acl.description: Determines last queried ACL for the specified IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and networks in scavenging settings.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

log_dtc_gslb.description: Determines whether the DTC GSLB activity is captured or not.

log_dtc_health.description: Determines whether the DTC health monitoring information is captured or not.

log_general.description: Determines whether the BIND messages that are not specifically classified are captured or not.

log_client.description: Determines whether the client requests are captured or not.

log_config.description: Determines whether the configuration file parsing is captured or not.

log_database.description: Determines whether the BIND's internal database processes are captured or not.

log_dnssec.description: Determines whether the DNSSEC-signed responses are captured or not.

log_lame_servers.description: Determines whether the bad delegation instances are captured or not.

log_network.description: Determines whether the network operation messages are captured or not.

log_notify.description: Determines whether the asynchronous zone change notification messages are captured or not.

log_queries.description: Determines whether the query messages are captured or not.

log_query_rewrite.description: Determines whether the query rewrite messages are captured or not.

log_responses.description: Determines whether the response messages are captured or not.

log_resolver.description: Determines whether the DNS resolution instances, including recursive queries from resolvers are captured or not.

log_security.description: Determines whether the approved and denied requests are captured or not.

log_update.description: Determines whether the dynamic update instances are captured or not.

log_xfer_in.description: Determines whether the zone transfer messages from the remote name servers to the appliance are captured or not.

log_xfer_out.description: Determines whether the zone transfer messages from the Infoblox appliance to remote name servers are captured or not.

log_update_security.description: Determines whether the security update messages are captured or not.

log_rate_limit.description: Determines whether the rate limit messages are captured or not.

log_rpz.description: Determines whether the Response Policy Zone messages are captured or not.

max_cache_ttl.description: The maximum time (in seconds) for which the server will cache positive answers.

max_cached_lifetime.description: The maximum time (in seconds) a DNS response can be stored in the hardware acceleration cache. Valid values are unsigned integer between 60 and 86400, inclusive.

max_ncache_ttl.description: The maximum time (in seconds) for which the server will cache negative (NXDOMAIN) responses. The maximum allowed value is 604800.

max_udp_size.description: The value is used by authoritative DNS servers to never send DNS responses larger than the configured value. The value should be between 512 and 4096 bytes. The recommended value is between 512 and 1220 bytes.

member_secondary_notify.description: Determines if Grid members that are authoritative secondary servers are allowed to send notification messages to external name servers, if the Grid member that is primary for a zone fails or loses connectivity.

negative_ttl.description: The negative TTL value of a Grid DNS object. This interval tells the secondary how long data can be cached for "Does Not Respond" responses.

notify_delay.description: Specifies with how many seconds of delay the notify messages are sent to secondaries.

notify_source_port.description: The source port for notify messages. When requesting zone transfers from the primary server, some secondary DNS servers use the source port number (the primary server used to send the notify message) as the destination port number in the zone transfer request. Valid values are between 1 and 63999. The default is picked by BIND.

nsgroups.description: A name server group is a collection of one primary DNS server and one or more secondary DNS servers.

nxdomain_log_query.description: Determines if NXDOMAIN redirection queries are logged or not.

nxdomain_redirect.description: Determines if NXDOMAIN redirection is enabled or not.

nxdomain_redirect_addresses.description: The list of IPv4 NXDOMAIN redirection addresses.

nxdomain_redirect_addresses_v6.description: The list of IPv6 NXDOMAIN redirection addresses.

nxdomain_redirect_ttl.description: The TTL value (in seconds) of synthetic DNS responses that result from NXDOMAIN redirection.

nxdomain_rulesets.description: The Ruleset object names assigned at the Grid level for NXDOMAIN redirection.

preserve_host_rrset_order_on_secondaries.description: Determines if the host RRset order on secondaries is preserved or not.

protocol_record_name_policies.description: The list of record name policies.

query_rewrite_domain_names.description: The list of domain names that trigger DNS query rewrite.

query_rewrite_prefix.description: The domain name prefix for DNS query rewrite.

query_source_port.description: The source port for queries. Specifying a source port number for recursive queries ensures that a firewall will allow the response. Valid values are between 1 and 63999. The default is picked by BIND.

recursive_query_list.description: The list of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, networks or hosts authenticated by Transaction signature (TSIG) key from which recursive queries are allowed or denied.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

refresh_timer.description: The refresh time. This interval tells the secondary how often to send a message to the primary for a zone to check that its data is current, and retrieve fresh data if it is not.

resolver_query_timeout.description: The recursive query timeout for the member.

enable_rrl.description: Determines if the response rate limiting is enabled or not.

log_only.description: Determines if logging for response rate limiting without dropping any requests is enabled or not.

responses_per_second.description: The number of responses per client per second.

window.description: The time interval in seconds over which responses are tracked.

slip.description: The response rate limiting slip. Note that if slip is not equal to 0 every n-th rate-limited UDP request is sent a truncated response instead of being dropped.

delay.description: The time duration to delay a restart for a restart group.

timeout.description: The duration of timeout for a restart group. The value "-1" means infinite.

restart_offline.description: Determines whether the Grid should try to restart offline member.

retry_timer.description: The retry time. This interval tells the secondary how long to wait before attempting to recontact the primary after a connection failure occurs between the two servers.

root_name_server_type.description: Determines the type of root name servers.

rpz_disable_nsdname_nsip.description: Determines if NSDNAME and NSIP resource records from RPZ feeds are enabled or not.

rpz_drop_ip_rule_enabled.description: Enables the appliance to ignore RPZ-IP triggers with prefix lengths less than the specified minimum prefix length.

rpz_drop_ip_rule_min_prefix_length_ipv4.description: The minimum prefix length for IPv4 RPZ-IP triggers. The appliance ignores RPZ-IP triggers with prefix lengths less than the specified minimum IPv4 prefix length.

rpz_drop_ip_rule_min_prefix_length_ipv6.description: The minimum prefix length for IPv6 RPZ-IP triggers. The appliance ignores RPZ-IP triggers with prefix lengths less than the specified minimum IPv6 prefix length.

rpz_qname_wait_recurse.description: Determines if recursive RPZ lookups are enabled.

enable_scavenging.description: This flag indicates if the resource record scavenging is enabled or not.

enable_recurrent_scavenging.description: This flag indicates if the recurrent resource record scavenging is enabled or not.

enable_auto_reclamation.description: This flag indicates if the automatic resource record scavenging is enabled or not.

enable_rr_last_queried.description: This flag indicates if the resource record last queried monitoring in affected zones is enabled or not.

enable_zone_last_queried.description: This flag indicates if the last queried monitoring for affected zones is enabled or not.

reclaim_associated_records.description: This flag indicates if the associated resource record scavenging is enabled or not.

scavenging_schedule.description: Schedule setting for cloud discovery task.

weekdays.description: Days of the week when scheduling is triggered.

time_zone.description: The time zone for the schedule.

recurring_time.description: The recurring time for the schedule in Epoch seconds format. This field is obsolete and is preserved only for backward compatibility purposes. Please use other applicable fields to define the recurring schedule. DO NOT use recurring_time together with these fields. If you use recurring_time with other fields to define the recurring schedule, recurring_time has priority over year, hour_of_day, and minutes_past_hour and will override the values of these fields, although it does not override month and day_of_month. In this case, the recurring time value might be different than the intended value that you define.

frequency.description: The frequency for the scheduled task.

every.description: The number of frequency to wait before repeating the scheduled task.

minutes_past_hour.description: The minutes past the hour for the scheduled task.

hour_of_day.description: The hour of day for the scheduled task.

year.description: The year for the scheduled task.

month.description: The month for the scheduled task.

day_of_month.description: The day of the month for the scheduled task.

repeat.description: Indicates if the scheduled task will be repeated or run only once.

disable.description: If set to True, the scheduled task is disabled.

expression_list.description: The expression list. The particular record is treated as reclaimable if expression condition evaluates to 'true' for given record if scavenging hasn't been manually disabled on a given resource record.

op1.description: The first operand value.

ea_expression_list.description: The extensible attributes expression list. The particular record is treated as reclaimable if extensible attributes expression condition evaluates to 'true' for given record if scavenging hasn't been manually disabled on a given resource record.

op1.description: The name of the Extensible Attribute Definition object which is used as the first operand value.

serial_query_rate.description: The number of maximum concurrent SOA queries per second. Valid values are unsigned integer between 20 and 1000, inclusive.

server_id_directive.description: The value of the server-id directive for BIND DNS.

sortlist.description: A sort list determines the order of addresses in responses made to DNS queries.

address.description: The source address of a sortlist object.

match_list.description: The match list of a sortlist.

store_locally.description: Determines if the storage of query capture reports on the appliance is enabled or disabled.

syslog_facility.description: The syslog facility. This is the location on the syslog server to which you want to sort the DNS logging messages.

transfer_excluded_servers.description: The list of excluded DNS servers during zone transfers.

transfer_format.description: The BIND format for a zone transfer. This provides tracking capabilities for single or multiple transfers and their associated servers.

transfers_in.description: The number of maximum concurrent transfers for the Grid. Valid values are unsigned integer between 10 and 10000, inclusive.

transfers_out.description: The number of maximum outbound concurrent zone transfers. Valid values are unsigned integer between 10 and 10000, inclusive.

transfers_per_ns.description: The number of maximum concurrent transfers per member. Valid values are unsigned integer between 2 and 10000, inclusive.

uuid.description: Universally Unique ID assigned for this object

zone_deletion_double_confirm.description: Determines if the double confirmation during zone deletion is enabled or not.

auto_create_reversezone.description: This flag controls whether reverse zones are automatically created when the network is added.

bootfile.description: The bootfile name for the network. You can configure the DHCP server to support clients that use the boot file name option in their DHCPREQUEST messages.

bootserver.description: The bootserver address for the network. You can specify the name and/or IP address of the boot server that the host needs to boot. The boot server IPv4 Address or name in FQDN format.

delegated_member.description: The Cloud Platform Appliance to which authority of the object is delegated.

ipv4addr.description: The IPv4 Address of the Grid Member.

ipv6addr.description: The IPv6 Address of the Grid Member.

delegated_scope.description: Indicates the scope of delegation for the object. This can be one of the following: NONE (outside any delegation), ROOT (the delegation point), SUBTREE (within the scope of a delegation), RECLAIMING (within the scope of a delegation being reclaimed, either as the delegation point or in the subtree).

delegated_root.description: Indicates the root of the delegation if delegated_scope is SUBTREE or RECLAIMING. This is not set otherwise.

owned_by_adaptor.description: Determines whether the object was created by the cloud adapter or not.

usage.description: Indicates the cloud origin of the object.

tenant.description: Reference to the tenant object associated with the object, if any.

mgmt_platform.description: Indicates the specified cloud management platform.

authority_type.description: Type of authority over the object.

cloud_shared.description: Boolean flag to indicate if the network is shared with cloud.

comment.description: Comment for the network, maximum 256 characters.

conflict_count.description: The number of conflicts discovered via network discovery.

ddns_domainname.description: The dynamic DNS domain name the appliance uses specifically for DDNS updates for this network.

ddns_generate_hostname.description: If this field is set to True, the DHCP server generates a hostname and updates DNS with it when the DHCP client request does not contain a hostname.

ddns_server_always_updates.description: This field controls whether only the DHCP server is allowed to update DNS, regardless of the DHCP clients requests. Note that changes for this field take effect only if ddns_use_option81 is True.

ddns_ttl.description: The DNS update Time to Live (TTL) value of a DHCP network object. The TTL is a 32-bit unsigned integer that represents the duration, in seconds, for which the update is cached. Zero indicates that the update is not cached.

ddns_update_fixed_addresses.description: By default, the DHCP server does not update DNS when it allocates a fixed address to a client. You can configure the DHCP server to update the A and PTR records of a client with a fixed address. When this feature is enabled and the DHCP server adds A and PTR records for a fixed address, the DHCP server never discards the records.

ddns_use_option81.description: The support for DHCP Option 81 at the network level.

delete_reason.description: The reason for deleting the RIR registration request.

deny_bootp.description: If set to true, BOOTP settings are disabled and BOOTP requests will be denied.

dhcp_utilization.description: The percentage of the total DHCP utilization of the network multiplied by 1000. This is the percentage of the total number of available IP addresses belonging to the network versus the total number of all IP addresses in network.

dhcp_utilization_status.description: A string describing the utilization level of the network.

disable.description: Determines whether a network is disabled or not. When this is set to False, the network is enabled.

discover_now_status.description: Discover now status for this network.

discovered_bgp_as.description: Number of the discovered BGP AS. When multiple BGP autonomous systems are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

discovered_vlan_id.description: The identifier of the discovered VLAN. When multiple VLANs are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

discovered_vlan_name.description: The name of the discovered VLAN. When multiple VLANs are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

discovered_vrf_description.description: Description of the discovered VRF. When multiple VRFs are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

discovered_vrf_name.description: The name of the discovered VRF. When multiple VRFs are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

discovered_vrf_rd.description: Route distinguisher of the discovered VRF. When multiple VRFs are discovered in the network, this field displays "Multiple".

port_scanning.description: Determines whether port scanning is enabled or not.

device_profile.description: Determines whether device profile is enabled or not.

snmp_collection.description: Determines whether SNMP collection is enabled or not.

cli_collection.description: Determines whether CLI collection is enabled or not.

netbios_scanning.description: Determines whether netbios scanning is enabled or not.

complete_ping_sweep.description: Determines whether complete ping sweep is enabled or not.

smart_subnet_ping_sweep.description: Determines whether smart subnet ping sweep is enabled or not.

auto_arp_refresh_before_switch_port_poll.description: Determines whether auto ARP refresh before switch port polling is enabled or not.

switch_port_data_collection_polling.description: A switch port data collection polling mode.

switch_port_data_collection_polling_sche.description: A Schedule Setting struct that determines switch port data collection polling schedule.

weekdays.description: Days of the week when scheduling is triggered.

time_zone.description: The time zone for the schedule.

recurring_time.description: The recurring time for the schedule in Epoch seconds format. This field is obsolete and is preserved only for backward compatibility purposes. Please use other applicable fields to define the recurring schedule. DO NOT use recurring_time together with these fields. If you use recurring_time with other fields to define the recurring schedule, recurring_time has priority over year, hour_of_day, and minutes_past_hour and will override the values of these fields, although it does not override month and day_of_month. In this case, the recurring time value might be different than the intended value that you define.

frequency.description: The frequency for the scheduled task.

every.description: The number of frequency to wait before repeating the scheduled task.

minutes_past_hour.description: The minutes past the hour for the scheduled task.

hour_of_day.description: The hour of day for the scheduled task.

year.description: The year for the scheduled task.

month.description: The month for the scheduled task.

day_of_month.description: The day of the month for the scheduled task.

repeat.description: Indicates if the scheduled task will be repeated or run only once.

disable.description: If set to True, the scheduled task is disabled.

switch_port_data_collection_polling_inte.description: Indicates the interval for switch port data collection polling.

high_water_mark.description: The percentage of DHCP network usage threshold above which network usage is not expected and may warrant your attention. deny_bootp.description: If set to true, BOOTP settings are disabled and BOOTP requests will be denied.

tcp_port.description: The TCP port the appliance must listen on.

udp_enable.description: If set to True, the appliance can receive messages from other devices via UDP.

udp_port.description: The UDP port the appliance must listen on.

client_acls.description: This list controls the IP addresses and networks that are allowed to access the syslog proxy.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key. If the external primary server is a NIOS appliance running DNS One 2.x code, this can be set to :2xCOMPAT.

tsig_key_name.description: The name of the TSIG key. If 2.x TSIG compatibility is used, this is set to 'tsig_xfer' on retrieval, and ignored on insert or update.

syslog_servers.description: The list of external syslog servers.

certificate.description: Reference to the underlying X509Certificate object grid:x509certificate.

certificate_token.description: The token returned by the uploadinit function call in object fileop.

connection_type.description: The connection type for communicating with this server.

port.description: The port this server listens on.

local_interface.description: The local interface through which the appliance sends syslog messages to the syslog server.

message_source.description: The source of syslog messages to be sent to the external syslog server. If set to 'INTERNAL', only messages the appliance generates will be sent to the syslog server. If set to 'EXTERNAL', the appliance sends syslog messages that it receives from other devices, such as syslog servers and routers. If set to 'ANY', the appliance sends both internal and external syslog messages.

message_node_id.description: Identify the node in the syslog message.

severity.description: The severity filter. The appliance sends log messages of the specified severity and above to the external syslog server.

category_list.description: The list of all syslog logging categories.

only_category_list.description: The list of selected syslog logging categories. The appliance forwards syslog messages that belong to the selected categories.

syslog_size.description: The maximum size for the syslog file expressed in megabytes.

threshold_traps.description: Determines the list of threshold traps. The user can only change the values for each trap or remove traps.

trap_type.description: Determines the type of a given trap.

trap_reset.description: Determines the threshold value to reset the trap.

trap_trigger.description: Determines the threshold value to trigger the trap.

time_zone.description: The time zone of the Grid member. The UTC string that represents the time zone, such as "Asia/Kolkata".

auth_dns_latency_trigger_enable.description: Enabling trigger automated traffic capture based on authoritative DNS latency.

auth_dns_latency_threshold.description: Authoritative DNS latency below which traffic capture will be triggered.

auth_dns_latency_reset.description: Authoritative DNS latency above which traffic capture will stopped.

auth_dns_latency_listen_on_source.description: The local IP DNS service is listen on (for authoritative DNS latency trigger).

auth_dns_latency_listen_on_ip.description: The DNS listen-on IP address used if auth_dns_latency_on_source is IP.

chr_trigger_enable.description: Enable triggering automated traffic capture based on cache hit ratio thresholds.

chr_threshold.description: DNS Cache hit ratio threshold(%) below which traffic capture will be triggered.

chr_reset.description: DNS Cache hit ratio threshold(%) above which traffic capture will be triggered.

chr_min_cache_utilization.description: Minimum DNS cache utilization threshold(%) for triggering traffic capture based on DNS cache hit ratio.

qps_trigger_enable.description: Enable triggering automated traffic capture based on DNS queries per second threshold.

qps_threshold.description: DNS queries per second threshold below which traffic capture will be triggered.

qps_reset.description: DNS queries per second threshold below which traffic capture will be stopped.

rec_dns_latency_trigger_enable.description: Enable triggering automated traffic capture based on recursive DNS latency.

rec_dns_latency_threshold.description: Recursive DNS latency below which traffic capture will be triggered.

rec_dns_latency_reset.description: Recursive DNS latency above which traffic capture will be stopped.

rec_dns_latency_listen_on_source.description: The local IP DNS service is listen on ( for recursive DNS latency trigger).

rec_dns_latency_listen_on_ip.description: The DNS listen-on IP address used if rec_dns_latency_listen_on_source is IP.

kpi_monitored_domains.description: List of domains monitored by 'Recursive DNS Latency Threshold' trigger.

domain_name.description: Domain name (FQDN to Query).

recursive_clients_count_trigger_enable.description: Enable triggering automated traffic capture based on outgoing recursive queries count.

recursive_clients_count_threshold.description: Concurrent outgoing recursive queries count below which traffic capture will be triggered.

recursive_clients_count_reset.description: Concurrent outgoing recursive queries count below which traffic capture will be stopped.

trap_notifications.description: Determines configuration of the trap notifications.

trap_type.description: Determines the type of a given trap.

enable_email.description: Determines if the email notifications for the given trap are enabled or not.

enable_trap.description: Determines if the trap is enabled or not.

upgrade_group.description: The name of the upgrade group to which this Grid member belongs.

use_automated_traffic_capture.description: This flag is the use flag for enabling automated traffic capture based on DNS cache ratio thresholds.

use_syslog_proxy_setting.description: Use flag for: external_syslog_server_enable , syslog_servers, syslog_proxy_setting, syslog_size

use_traffic_capture_auth_dns.description: This flag is the use flag for enabling automated traffic capture based on authoritative DNS latency.

use_traffic_capture_chr.description: This flag is the use flag for automated traffic capture settings at member level.

use_traffic_capture_qps.description: This flag is the use flag for enabling automated traffic capture based on DNS queries per second thresholds.

use_traffic_capture_rec_dns.description: This flag is the use flag for enabling automated traffic capture based on recursive DNS latency.

use_traffic_capture_rec_queries.description: This flag is the use flag for enabling automated traffic capture based on outgoing recursive queries.

use_v4_vrrp.description: Specify "true" to use VRRPv4 or "false" to use VRRPv6.

uuid.description: Universally Unique ID assigned for this object

address.description: The IPv4 Address of the Grid Member.

gateway.description: The default gateway for the Grid Member.

subnet_mask.description: The subnet mask for the Grid Member.

vlan_id.description: The identifier for the VLAN. Valid values are from 1 to 4096.

primary.description: Determines if the current address is the primary VLAN address or not.

dscp.description: The DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) value determines relative priorities for the type of services on your network. The appliance implements QoS (Quality of Service) rules based on this configuration. Valid values are from 0 to 63.

lan_subnet_mask.description: LAN netmask only for GCP HA.

lan_gateway.description: LAN gateway only for GCP HA.

auth_server_group.description: The Authentication Server Group object associated with this member.

authn_captive_portal.description: The captive portal responsible for authenticating this DHCP member.

authn_captive_portal_authenticated_filte.description: The MAC filter representing the authenticated range.

authn_captive_portal_enabled.description: The flag that controls if this DHCP member is enabled for captive portal authentication.

authn_captive_portal_guest_filter.description: The MAC filter representing the guest range.

authn_server_group_enabled.description: The flag that controls if this DHCP member can send authentication requests to an authentication server group.

authority.description: The authority flag of a Grid member. This flag specifies if a DHCP server is authoritative for a domain.

bootfile.description: The name of a file that DHCP clients need to boot. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

bootserver.description: The name of the server on which a boot file is stored. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

ddns_domainname.description: The member DDNS domain name value.

ddns_generate_hostname.description: Determines the ability of a member DHCP server to generate a host name and update DNS with this host name when it receives a DHCP REQUEST message that does not include a host name.

ddns_retry_interval.description: Determines the retry interval when the member DHCP server makes repeated attempts to send DDNS updates to a DNS server.

ddns_server_always_updates.description: Determines that only the DHCP server is allowed to update DNS, regardless of the requests from the DHCP clients. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

ddns_ttl.description: The DDNS TTL (Dynamic DNS Time To Live) value specifies the number of seconds an IP address for the name is cached.

ddns_update_fixed_addresses.description: Determines if the member DHCP server's ability to update the A and PTR records with a fixed address is enabled or not.

ddns_use_option81.description: Determines if support for option 81 is enabled or not.

ddns_zone_primaries.description: An ordered list of zone primaries that will receive DDNS updates.

dns_grid_zone.description: The ref of a DNS zone.

dns_grid_primary.description: The name of a Grid member.

dns_ext_zone.description: The name of external zone in FQDN format.

dns_ext_primary.description: The IP address of the External server. Valid when zone_match is "EXTERNAL" or "ANY_EXTERNAL".

deny_bootp.description: Determines if a BOOTP server denies BOOTP request or not. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

dhcp_utilization.description: The percentage of the total DHCP utilization of DHCP objects belonging to the Grid Member multiplied by 1000. This is the percentage of the total number of available IP addresses from all the DHCP objects belonging to the Grid Member versus the total number of all IP addresses in all of the DHCP objects on the Grid Member.

dhcp_utilization_status.description: A string describing the utilization level of DHCP objects that belong to the Grid Member.

dns_update_style.description: The update style for dynamic DNS updates.

dynamic_hosts.description: The total number of DHCP leases issued for the DHCP objects on the Grid Member.

email_list.description: The email_list value of a member DHCP server.

enable_ddns.description: Determines if the member DHCP server's ability to send DDNS updates is enabled or not.

enable_dhcp.description: Determines if the DHCP service of a member is enabled or not.

enable_dhcp_on_ipv6_lan2.description: Determines if the DHCP service on the IPv6 LAN2 interface is enabled or not.

enable_dhcp_on_lan2.description: Determines if the DHCP service on the LAN2 interface is enabled or not.

enable_dhcp_thresholds.description: Represents the watermarks above or below which address usage in a network is unexpected and might warrant your attention. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

enable_dhcpv6_service.description: Determines if DHCPv6 service for the member is enabled or not.

enable_email_warnings.description: Determines if e-mail warnings are enabled or disabled. When DHCP threshold is enabled and DHCP address usage crosses a watermark threshold, the appliance sends an e-mail notification to an administrator.

enable_fingerprint.description: Determines if fingerprint feature is enabled on this member. If you enable this feature, the server will match a fingerprint for incoming lease requests.

enable_gss_tsig.description: Determines whether the appliance is enabled to receive GSS-TSIG authenticated updates from DHCP clients.

enable_hostname_rewrite.description: Determines if the Grid member's host name rewrite feature is enabled or not.

enable_leasequery.description: Determines if lease query is allowed or not. This setting overrides the Grid-level setting.

enable_snmp_warnings.description: Determines if SNMP warnings are enabled or disabled on this DHCP member. When DHCP threshold is enabled and DHCP address usage crosses a watermark threshold, the appliance sends an SNMP trap to the trap receiver that was defined for the Grid member level.

value.description: The value of the extensible attribute.

additionalProperties.description: Extensible attributes associated with the object.

failover_association_ip_count.description: Total number of IPs associated with IPv4 DHCP failover associations for the member.

gss_tsig_keys.description: The list of GSS-TSIG keys for a member DHCP object.

high_water_mark.description: Determines the high watermark value of a member DHCP server. If the percentage of allocated addresses exceeds this watermark, the appliance makes a syslog entry and sends an e-mail notification (if enabled). Specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100.

high_water_mark_reset.description: Determines the high watermark reset value of a member DHCP server. If the percentage of allocated addresses drops below this value, a corresponding SNMP trap is reset. Specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100. The high watermark reset value must be lower than the high watermark value.

host_name.description: Host name of the Grid member.

hostname_rewrite_policy.description: The hostname rewrite policy that is in the protocol hostname rewrite policies array of the Grid DHCP object. This attribute is mandatory if enable_hostname_rewrite is "true".

ignore_dhcp_option_list_request.description: Determines if the ignore DHCP option list request flag of a Grid member DHCP is enabled or not. If this flag is set to true all available DHCP options will be returned to the client.

ignore_id.description: Indicates whether the appliance will ignore DHCP client IDs or MAC addresses. Valid values are "NONE", "CLIENT", or "MACADDR". The default is "NONE".

ignore_mac_addresses.description: A list of MAC addresses the appliance will ignore.

immediate_fa_configuration.description: Determines if the Immediate Fixed address configuration apply feature for the DHCP member is enabled or not.

ipv4addr.description: The IPv4 Address of the Grid member.

ipv6_ddns_domainname.description: The member DDNS IPv6 domain name value.

ipv6_ddns_enable_option_fqdn.description: Controls whether the FQDN option sent by the DHCPv6 client is to be used, or if the server can automatically generate the FQDN.

ipv6_ddns_hostname.description: The member IPv6 DDNS hostname value.

ipv6_ddns_server_always_updates.description: Determines if the server always updates DNS or updates only if requested by the client.

ipv6_ddns_ttl.description: The member IPv6 DDNS TTL value.

ipv6_dns_update_style.description: The update style for dynamic DHCPv6 DNS updates.

ipv6_domain_name_servers.description: The comma separated list of domain name server addresses in IPv6 address format.

ipv6_enable_ddns.description: Determines if sending DDNS updates by the member DHCPv6 server is enabled or not.

ipv6_enable_gss_tsig.description: Determines whether the appliance is enabled to receive GSS-TSIG authenticated updates from DHCPv6 clients.

ipv6_enable_lease_scavenging.description: Indicates whether DHCPv6 lease scavenging is enabled or disabled.

ipv6_enable_retry_updates.description: Determines if the DHCPv6 server retries failed dynamic DNS updates or not.

ipv6_generate_hostname.description: Determines if the server generates the hostname if it is not sent by the client.

ipv6_gss_tsig_keys.description: The list of GSS-TSIG keys for a member DHCPv6 object.

ipv6_kdc_server.description: Determines the IPv6 address or FQDN of the Kerberos server for DHCPv6 GSS-TSIG authentication. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

ipv6_lease_scavenging_time.description: The member-level grace period (in seconds) to keep an expired lease before it is deleted by the scavenging process.

ipv6_microsoft_code_page.description: The Microsoft client DHCP IPv6 code page value of a Grid member. This value is the hostname translation code page for Microsoft DHCP IPv6 clients and overrides the Grid level Microsoft DHCP IPv6 client code page.

ipv6_options.description: An array of DHCP option dhcpoption structs that lists the DHCPv6 options associated with the object.

num.description: The code of the DHCP option.

vendor_class.description: The name of the space this DHCP option is associated to.

value.description: Value of the DHCP option

use_option.description: Only applies to special options that are displayed separately from other options and have a use flag. These options are: * routers * router-templates * domain-name-servers * domain-name * broadcast-address * broadcast-address-offset * dhcp-lease-time * dhcp6.name-servers

ipv6_recycle_leases.description: Determines if the IPv6 recycle leases feature is enabled or not. If the feature is enabled, leases are kept in the Recycle Bin until one week after lease expiration. When the feature is disabled, the leases are irrecoverably deleted.

ipv6_remember_expired_client_association.description: Enable binding for expired DHCPv6 leases.

ipv6_retry_updates_interval.description: Determines the retry interval when the member DHCPv6 server makes repeated attempts to send DDNS updates to a DNS server.

ipv6_server_duid.description: The server DHCPv6 unique identifier (DUID) for the Grid member.

ipv6_update_dns_on_lease_renewal.description: Controls whether the DHCPv6 server updates DNS when an IPv6 DHCP lease is renewed.

ipv6addr.description: The IPv6 Address of the Grid member.

kdc_server.description: The IPv4 address or FQDN of the Kerberos server for DHCPv4 GSS-TSIG authentication. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

lease_per_client_settings.description: Defines how the appliance releases DHCP leases. Valid values are "RELEASE_MACHING_ID", "NEVER_RELEASE", or "ONE_LEASE_PER_CLIENT". The default is "RELEASE_MATCHING_ID".

lease_scavenge_time.description: Determines the lease scavenging time value. When this field is set, the appliance permanently deletes the free and backup leases that remain in the database beyond a specified period of time. To disable lease scavenging, set the parameter to -1. The minimum positive value must be greater than 86400 seconds (1 day).

log_lease_events.description: This value specifies whether the grid member logs lease events. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

logic_filter_rules.description: This field contains the logic filters to be applied on the Grid member. This list corresponds to the match rules that are written to the dhcpd configuration file.

type.description: The filter type. Valid values are: * MAC * NAC * Option

low_water_mark.description: Determines the low watermark value. If the percent of allocated addresses drops below this watermark, the appliance makes a syslog entry and sends an e-mail notification (if enabled).

low_water_mark_reset.description: Determines the low watermark reset value. If the percentage of allocated addresses exceeds this value, a corresponding SNMP trap is reset. A number that specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100. The low watermark reset value must be higher than the low watermark value.

max_failover_association_ip_count.description: Maximum number of IPs that can be associated with IPv4 DHCP failover associations for the member.

microsoft_code_page.description: The Microsoft client DHCP IPv4 code page value of a grid member. This value is the hostname translation code page for Microsoft DHCP IPv4 clients and overrides the Grid level Microsoft DHCP IPv4 client code page.

nextserver.description: The next server value of a member DHCP server. This value is the IP address or name of the boot file server on which the boot file is stored.

option_space.description: The option space for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

is_substring.description: Determines if the match value is a substring.

substring_offset.description: The offset of match value for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

substring_length.description: The length of match value for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

prefix_length_mode.description: The Prefix length mode for DHCPv6.

ipv6_gss_tsig_keys.description: The list of GSS-TSIG keys for a member DHCPv6 object.

ipv6_kdc_server.description: Determines the IPv6 address or FQDN of the Kerberos server for DHCPv6 GSS-TSIG authentication. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

ipv6_lease_scavenging_time.description: The member-level grace period (in seconds) to keep an expired lease before it is deleted by the scavenging process.

ipv6_microsoft_code_page.description: The Microsoft client DHCP IPv6 code page value of a Grid member. This value is the hostname translation code page for Microsoft DHCP IPv6 clients and overrides the Grid level Microsoft DHCP IPv6 client code page.

ipv6_options.description: An array of DHCP option dhcpoption structs that lists the DHCPv6 options associated with the object.

num.description: The code of the DHCP option.

vendor_class.description: The name of the space this DHCP option is associated to.

value.description: Value of the DHCP option

use_option.description: Only applies to special options that are displayed separately from other options and have a use flag. These options are: * routers * router-templates * domain-name-servers * domain-name * broadcast-address * broadcast-address-offset * dhcp-lease-time * dhcp6.name-servers

ipv6_recycle_leases.description: Determines if the IPv6 recycle leases feature is enabled or not. If the feature is enabled, leases are kept in the Recycle Bin until one week after lease expiration. When the feature is disabled, the leases are irrecoverably deleted.

ipv6_remember_expired_client_association.description: Enable binding for expired DHCPv6 leases.

ipv6_retry_updates_interval.description: Determines the retry interval when the member DHCPv6 server makes repeated attempts to send DDNS updates to a DNS server.

ipv6_server_duid.description: The server DHCPv6 unique identifier (DUID) for the Grid member.

ipv6_update_dns_on_lease_renewal.description: Controls whether the DHCPv6 server updates DNS when an IPv6 DHCP lease is renewed.

ipv6addr.description: The IPv6 Address of the Grid member.

kdc_server.description: The IPv4 address or FQDN of the Kerberos server for DHCPv4 GSS-TSIG authentication. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

lease_per_client_settings.description: Defines how the appliance releases DHCP leases. Valid values are "RELEASE_MACHING_ID", "NEVER_RELEASE", or "ONE_LEASE_PER_CLIENT". The default is "RELEASE_MATCHING_ID".

lease_scavenge_time.description: Determines the lease scavenging time value. When this field is set, the appliance permanently deletes the free and backup leases that remain in the database beyond a specified period of time. To disable lease scavenging, set the parameter to -1. The minimum positive value must be greater than 86400 seconds (1 day).

log_lease_events.description: This value specifies whether the grid member logs lease events. This setting overrides the Grid level setting.

logic_filter_rules.description: This field contains the logic filters to be applied on the Grid member. This list corresponds to the match rules that are written to the dhcpd configuration file.

type.description: The filter type. Valid values are: * MAC * NAC * Option

low_water_mark.description: Determines the low watermark value. If the percent of allocated addresses drops below this watermark, the appliance makes a syslog entry and sends an e-mail notification (if enabled).

low_water_mark_reset.description: Determines the low watermark reset value. If the percentage of allocated addresses exceeds this value, a corresponding SNMP trap is reset. A number that specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100. The low watermark reset value must be higher than the low watermark value.

max_failover_association_ip_count.description: Maximum number of IPs that can be associated with IPv4 DHCP failover associations for the member.

microsoft_code_page.description: The Microsoft client DHCP IPv4 code page value of a grid member. This value is the hostname translation code page for Microsoft DHCP IPv4 clients and overrides the Grid level Microsoft DHCP IPv4 client code page.

nextserver.description: The next server value of a member DHCP server. This value is the IP address or name of the boot file server on which the boot file is stored.

option60_match_rules.description: The list of option 60 match rules.

match_value.description: The match value for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

option_space.description: The option space for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

is_substring.description: Determines if the match value is a substring.

substring_offset.description: The offset of match value for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

substring_length.description: The length of match value for this DHCP Option 60 match rule.

options.description: An array of DHCP option dhcpoption structs that lists the DHCP options associated with the object.

num.description: The code of the DHCP option.

vendor_class.description: The name of the space this DHCP option is associated to.

value.description: Value of the DHCP option

use_option.description: Only applies to special options that are displayed separately from other options and have a use flag. These options are: * routers * router-templates * domain-name-servers * domain-name * broadcast-address * broadcast-address-offset * dhcp-lease-time * dhcp6.name-servers

ping_count.description: Specifies the number of pings that the Infoblox appliance sends to an IP address to verify that it is not in use. Values are from 0 to 10, where 0 disables pings.

ping_timeout.description: Indicates the number of milliseconds the appliance waits for a response to its ping. Valid values are 100, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000 and 5000 milliseconds.

preferred_lifetime.description: The preferred lifetime value.

prefix_length_mode.description: The Prefix length mode for DHCPv6.

pxe_lease_time.description: Specifies the duration of time it takes a host to connect to a boot server, such as a TFTP server, and download the file it needs to boot. A 32-bit unsigned integer that represents the duration, in seconds, for which the update is cached. Zero indicates that the update is not cached.

recycle_leases.description: Determines if the recycle leases feature is enabled or not. If you enabled this feature and then delete a DHCP range, the appliance stores active leases from this range up to one week after the leases expires.

retry_ddns_updates.description: Indicates whether the DHCP server makes repeated attempts to send DDNS updates to a DNS server.

static_hosts.description: The number of static DHCP addresses configured in DHCP objects that belong to the Grid Member.

syslog_facility.description: The syslog facility is the location on the syslog server to which you want to sort the syslog messages.

total_hosts.description: The total number of DHCP addresses configured in DHCP objects that belong to the Grid Member.

update_dns_on_lease_renewal.description: Controls whether the DHCP server updates DNS when a DHCP lease is renewed.

use_enable_dhcp_thresholds.description: Use flag for: enable_dhcp_thresholds , high_water_mark, high_water_mark_reset, low_water_mark, low_water_mark_reset

use_ipv6_lease_scavenging.description: Use flag for: ipv6_enable_lease_scavenging , ipv6_lease_scavenging_time, ipv6_remember_expired_client_association

uuid.description: Universally Unique ID assigned for this object

valid_lifetime.description: The valid lifetime for Grid Member DHCP. Specifies the length of time addresses that are assigned to DHCPv6 clients remain in the valid state.

add_client_ip_mac_options.description: Add custom IP, MAC and DNS View name ENDS0 options to outgoing recursive queries.

additional_ip_list.description: The list of additional IP addresses on which DNS is enabled for a Grid member. Only one of "additional_ip_list" or "additional_ip_list_struct" should be set when modifying the object.

additional_ip_list_struct.description: The list of additional IP addresses and IP Space Discriminator short names on which DNS is enabled for a Grid member. Only one of "additional_ip_list" or "additional_ip_list_struct" should be set when modifying the object.

ip_address.description: The additional IP address of the member.

allow_gss_tsig_zone_updates.description: Determines whether the GSS-TSIG zone updates is enabled for the Grid member.

allow_query.description: Determines if queries from specified IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and networks are enabled or not. The appliance can also use Transaction Signature (TSIG) keys to authenticate the queries. This setting overrides the Grid query settings.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key. If the external primary server is a NIOS appliance running DNS One 2.x code, this can be set to :2xCOMPAT.

tsig_key_name.description: The name of the TSIG key. If 2.x TSIG compatibility is used, this is set to 'tsig_xfer' on retrieval, and ignored on insert or update.

allow_recursive_query.description: Determines if the responses to recursive queries is enabled or not. This setting overrides Grid recursive query settings.

allow_transfer.description: Allows or rejects zone transfers from specified IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and networks or allows transfers from hosts authenticated by Transaction signature (TSIG) key. This setting overrides the Grid zone transfer settings.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key. If the external primary server is a NIOS appliance running DNS One 2.x code, this can be set to :2xCOMPAT.

tsig_key_name.description: The name of the TSIG key. If 2.x TSIG compatibility is used, this is set to 'tsig_xfer' on retrieval, and ignored on insert or update.

allow_update.description: Allows or rejects dynamic updates from specified IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, networks or from host authenticated by TSIG key. This setting overrides Grid update settings.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key. If the external primary server is a NIOS appliance running DNS One 2.x code, this can be set to :2xCOMPAT.

tsig_key_name.description: The name of the TSIG key. If 2.x TSIG compatibility is used, this is set to 'tsig_xfer' on retrieval, and ignored on insert or update.

anonymize_response_logging.description: The flag that indicates whether the anonymization of captured DNS responses is enabled or disabled.

atc_fwd_enable.description: Enable DNS recursive query forwarding to Active Trust Cloud.

detect_chr.description: Configuration for detecting changes for the Cache Hit Ratio (CHR) of recursive queries.

enable.description: Determines if DNS attack detection is enabled or not.

high.description: The high threshold value (in percentage) for starting DNS attack detection.

interval_max.description: The maximum number of events that have occurred before processing DNS attack detection.

interval_min.description: The minimum number of events that have occurred before processing DNS attack detection.

interval_time.description: The time interval between detection processing.

low.description: The low threshold value (in percentage) for starting DNS attack detection.

detect_chr_grace.description: The cache utilization (in percentage) when Cache Hit Ratio (CHR) starts.

detect_nxdomain_responses.description: Configuration for detecting NXDOMAIN responses from up-stream servers to all incoming recursive responses.

enable.description: Determines if DNS attack detection is enabled or not.

high.description: The high threshold value (in percentage) for starting DNS attack detection.

interval_max.description: The maximum number of events that have occurred before processing DNS attack detection.

interval_min.description: The minimum number of events that have occurred before processing DNS attack detection.

interval_time.description: The time interval between detection processing.

detect_udp_drop.description: Configuration for detecting the UDP packet drop rate.

interval_time.description: The time interval between detection processing.

enable_fetches_per_server.description: Enables or disables the configuration of the maximum number of concurrent recursive queries the appliance sends to each upstream DNS server.

enable_fetches_per_zone.description: Enables or disables the configuration of the maximum number of concurrent recursive queries the appliance sends to each DNS zone.

enable_holddown.description: Enables or disables the holddown configuration when the appliance stops sending queries to non-responsive servers.

fetches_per_server.description: The maximum number of concurrent recursive queries the appliance sends to a single upstream name server before blocking additional queries to that server.

fetches_per_zone.description: The maximum number of concurrent recursive queries that a server sends for its domains.

fps_freq.description: Determines how often (in number of recursive responses) the appliance recalculates the average timeout ratio for each DNS server.

holddown.description: The holddown duration for non-responsive servers.

holddown_threshold.description: The number of consecutive timeouts before holding down a non-responsive server.

holddown_timeout.description: The minimum time (in seconds) that needs to be passed before a timeout occurs. Note that only these timeouts are counted towards the number of consecutive timeouts.

auto_create_a_and_ptr_for_lan2.description: Determines if the auto-generation of A and PTR records for the LAN2 IP address is enabled or not, if DNS service is enabled on LAN2.

auto_create_aaaa_and_ipv6ptr_for_lan2.description: Determines if auto-generation of AAAA and IPv6 PTR records for LAN2 IPv6 address is enabled or not.

auto_sort_views.description: Determines if a Grid member to automatically sort DNS views is enabled or not. The order of the DNS views determines the order in which the appliance checks the match lists.

bind_check_names_policy.description: The BIND check names policy, which indicates the action the appliance takes when it encounters host names that do not comply with the Strict Hostname Checking policy. This method applies only if the host name restriction policy is set to 'Strict Hostname Checking'.

bind_hostname_directive.description: The value of the hostname directive for BIND.

bind_hostname_directive_fqdn.description: The value of the user-defined hostname directive for BIND. To enable user-defined hostname directive, you must set the bind_hostname_directive to "USER_DEFINED".

blackhole_list.description: The list of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses and networks from which DNS queries are blocked. This setting overrides the Grid blackhole_list.

address.description: The address this rule applies to or "Any".

permission.description: The permission to use for this address.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key. If the external primary server is a NIOS appliance running DNS One 2.x code, this can be set to :2xCOMPAT.

tsig_key_name.description: The name of the TSIG key. If 2.x TSIG compatibility is used, this is set to 'tsig_xfer' on retrieval, and ignored on insert or update.

blacklist_action.description: The action to perform when a domain name matches the pattern defined in a rule that is specified by the blacklist_ruleset method.

blacklist_log_query.description: Determines if blacklist redirection queries are logged or not.

blacklist_redirect_addresses.description: The IP addresses the appliance includes in the response it sends in place of a blacklisted IP address.

blacklist_redirect_ttl.description: The TTL value of the synthetic DNS responses that result from blacklist redirection.

blacklist_rulesets.description: The DNS Ruleset object names assigned at the Grid level for blacklist redirection.

capture_dns_queries_on_all_domains.description: The flag that indicates whether the capture of DNS queries for all domains is enabled or disabled.

check_names_for_ddns_and_zone_transfer.description: Determines whether the application of BIND check-names for zone transfers and DDNS updates are enabled.

copy_client_ip_mac_options.description: Copy custom IP, MAC and DNS View name ENDS0 options from incoming to outgoing recursive queries.

copy_xfer_to_notify.description: Copies the allowed IPs from the zone transfer list into the also-notify statement in the named.conf file.

custom_root_name_servers.description: The list of custom root name servers. You can either select and use Internet root name servers or specify custom root name servers by providing a host name and IP address to which the Infoblox appliance can send queries.

address.description: The IPv4 Address or IPv6 Address of the server.

name.description: A resolvable domain name for the external DNS server.

shared_with_ms_parent_delegation.description: This flag represents whether the name server is shared with the parent Microsoft primary zone's delegation server.

stealth.description: Set this flag to hide the NS record for the primary name server from DNS queries.

tsig_key.description: A generated TSIG key.

tsig_key_name.description: The TSIG key name.

disable_edns.description: The EDNS0 support for queries that require recursive resolution on Grid members.

dns64_groups.description: The list of DNS64 synthesis groups associated with this member.

dns_cache_acceleration_ttl.description: The minimum TTL value, in seconds, that a DNS record must have in order for it to be cached by the DNS Cache Acceleration service. An integer from 1 to 65000 that represents the TTL in seconds.

dns_health_check_anycast_control.description: The flag that indicates whether the anycast failure (BFD session down) is enabled on member failure or not.

dns_health_check_domain_list.description: The list of domain names for the DNS health check.

dns_health_check_interval.description: The time interval (in seconds) for DNS health check.

dns_health_check_recursion_flag.description: The flag that indicates whether the recursive DNS health check is enabled or not.

dns_health_check_retries.description: The number of DNS health check retries.

dns_health_check_timeout.description: The DNS health check timeout interval (in seconds).

dns_notify_transfer_source.description: Determines which IP address is used as the source for DDNS notify and transfer operations.

dns_notify_transfer_source_address.description: The source address used if dns_notify_transfer_source type is "IP".

dns_over_https_endpoint.description: DoH end point. Available in WAPI 2.14 and later

dns_over_https_stream_per_connection.description: DNS over HTTPS streams per connection. Available in WAPI 2.14 and later

dns_query_capture_file_time_limit.description: The time limit (in minutes) for the DNS query capture file.

dns_query_source_address.description: The source address used if dns_query_source_interface type is "IP".

dns_query_source_interface.description: Determines which IP address is used as the source for DDNS query operations.

dns_view_address_settings.description: Array of notify/query source settings for views.

dns_notify_transfer_source.description: Determines which IP address is used as the source for DDNS notify and transfer operations.

dns_notify_transfer_source_address.description: The source address used if dns_notify_transfer_source type is "IP".

dns_query_source_interface.description: Determines which IP address is used as the source for DDNS query operations.

dns_query_source_address.description: The source address used if dns_query_source_interface type is "IP".

enable_notify_source_port.description: Determines if the notify source port for a view is enabled or not.

notify_source_port.description: The source port for notify messages. When requesting zone transfers from the primary server, some secondary DNS servers use the source port number (the primary server used to send the notify message) as the destination port number in the zone transfer request. This setting overrides Grid static source port settings. Valid values are between 1 and 63999. The default is selected by BIND.

enable_query_source_port.description: Determines if the query source port for a view is enabled or not.

query_source_port.description: The source port for queries. Specifying a source port number for recursive queries ensures that a firewall will allow the response. Valid values are between 1 and 63999. The default is selected by BIND.

notify_delay.description: Specifies the number of seconds of delay the notify messages are sent to secondaries.

use_source_ports.description: Use flag for: enable_notify_source_port , notify_source_port, enable_query_source_port, query_source_port

dnssec_blacklist_enabled.description: Determines if the blacklist rules for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_dns64_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS64 groups for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS security extension is enabled or not.

dnssec_expired_signatures_enabled.description: Determines when the DNS member accepts expired signatures.

dnssec_negative_trust_anchors.description: A list of zones for which the server does not perform DNSSEC validation.

dnssec_nxdomain_enabled.description: Determines if the NXDOMAIN rules for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_rpz_enabled.description: Determines if the RPZ policies for DNSSEC-enabled clients are enabled or not.

dnssec_trusted_keys.description: The list of trusted keys for the DNSSEC feature.

fqdn.description: The FQDN of the domain for which the member validates responses to recursive queries.

algorithm.description: The DNSSEC algorithm used to generate the key.

secure_entry_point.description: The secure entry point flag, if set it means this is a KSK configuration.

dnssec_must_be_secure.description: Responses must be DNSSEC secure for this hierarchy/domain.

dnssec_validation_enabled.description: Determines if the DNS security validation is enabled or not.

dnstap_identity.description: The DNSTAP identity string for this member.

dnstap_receiver_address_or_fqdn.description: Address or FQDN of DNSTAP receiver.

domains_to_capture_dns_queries.description: The list of domains for DNS query capture.

dtc_dns_queries_specific_behavior.description: Setting to control specific behavior for DTC DNS responses for incoming lbdn matched queries.

dtc_edns_prefer_client_subnet.description: Determines whether to prefer the client address from the edns-client-subnet option for DTC or not.

dtc_health_source_address.description: The source address used if dtc_health_source type is "IP".

edns_udp_size.description: Advertises the EDNS0 buffer size to the upstream server. The value should be between 512 and 4096 bytes. The recommended value is between 512 and 1220 bytes.

enable_blackhole.description: Determines if the blocking of DNS queries is enabled or not. This setting overrides the Grid enable_blackhole settings.

enable_blacklist.description: Determines if a blacklist is enabled or not on the Grid member.

enable_capture_dns_queries.description: The flag that indicates whether the capture of DNS queries is enabled or disabled.

enable_capture_dns_responses.description: The flag that indicates whether the capture of DNS responses is enabled or disabled.

enable_dns_cache_acceleration.description: Determines if the DNS Cache Acceleration service is enabled or not for a member.

enable_dns_health_check.description: The flag that indicates whether the DNS health check is enabled or not.

enable_dnstap_auth_responses.description: Enable DNSTAP for authoritative response messages.

enable_dnstap_violations_tls.description: Determines whether the violations messages need to be forwarded to DNSTAP or not.

enable_fixed_rrset_order_fqdns.description: Determines if the fixed RRset order FQDN is enabled or not.

enable_ftc.description: Determines whether Fault Tolerant Caching (FTC) is enabled.

enable_gss_tsig.description: Determines whether the appliance is enabled to receive GSS-TSIG authenticated updates from DHCP clients.

enable_query_rewrite.description: Determines if the DNS query rewrite is enabled or not for this member.

enable_query_source_port.description: Determines if the query source port for a member is enabled or not.

max_cache_ttl.description: The maximum time (in seconds) for which the server will cache positive answers.

max_ncache_ttl.description: The maximum time (in seconds) for which the server will cache negative (NXDOMAIN) responses. The maximum allowed value is 604800.

max_udp_size.description: The value is used by authoritative DNS servers to never send DNS responses larger than the configured value. The value should be between 512 and 4096 bytes. The recommended value is between 512 and 1220 bytes.

minimal_resp.description: Enables the ability to return a minimal amount of data in response to a query. This capability speeds up the DNS services provided by the appliance.

notify_delay.description: Specifies the number of seconds of delay the notify messages are sent to secondaries.

nxdomain_log_query.description: Determines if NXDOMAIN redirection queries are logged or not.

nxdomain_redirect_ttl.description: The TTL value of synthetic DNS responses that result from NXDOMAIN redirection.

nxdomain_rulesets.description: The names of the Ruleset objects assigned at the Grid level for NXDOMAIN redirection.

query_source_port.description: The source port for queries. Specifying a source port number for recursive queries ensures that a firewall will allow the response. Valid values are between 1 and 63999. The default is selected by BIND.

When the high watermark is reached, the Infoblox appliance generates a syslog message and sends a warning (if enabled). A number that specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100.

high_water_mark_reset.description: The percentage of DHCP network container usage below which the corresponding SNMP trap is reset. A number that specifies the percentage of allocated addresses. The range is from 1 to 100. The high watermark reset value must be lower than the high watermark value.

ignore_dhcp_option_list_request.description: If this field is set to False, the appliance returns all DHCP options the client is eligible to receive, rather than only the list of options the client has requested.

ipam_email_addresses.description: The e-mail lists to which the appliance sends IPAM threshold alarm e-mail messages.

To disable lease scavenging, set the parameter to -1. The minimum positive value must be greater than 86400 seconds (1 day).

logic_filter_rules.description: This field contains the logic filters to be applied on the this network container. This list corresponds to the match rules that are written to the dhcpd configuration file.

The range is from 1 to 100. The low watermark reset value must be higher than the low watermark value.
